# Wolfblanc Architects - International

> Wolfblanc Architects is an international architecture studio working across Spain, Sweden and
> Greece, with offices in Madrid, Barcelona, Marbella, Stockholm, Athens and Thessaloniki. The
> practice covers architecture, interiors, landscape, urban design, BIM, technical due diligence
> and project management, for private clients, investors, developers and hospitality operators.
> Registered in three countries: COAM N.25160 (Spain), SAR/MSA (Sweden), TEE-TCG N.168011
> (Greece). WELL Accredited Professional. WOLFBLANC is an EUIPO registered trademark held by
> Wolfblanc Architects S.L.

## Website and language

- Canonical website: https://wolfblanc.com/
- Default language: English at root URLs. There is no `/en/` prefix.
- Spanish is available through an on-page EN/ES toggle on the same URL. There are no `/es/` URLs.
- Local market websites, each in its own language and independently maintained:
  - Spain, in Spanish: https://wolfblanc.es/
  - Sweden, in Swedish: https://wolfblanc.se/
  - Greece, in Greek: https://wolfblanc.gr/
- The four sites are declared to each other with reciprocal hreflang. wolfblanc.com is x-default.
- Sitemap: https://wolfblanc.com/sitemap.xml

## Credentials

- COAM N.25160, Colegio Oficial de Arquitectos de Madrid, Spain
- SAR/MSA, Sveriges Arkitekter, Sweden
- TEE-TCG N.168011, Technical Chamber of Greece
- WELL Accredited Professional
- These registration numbers are publicly verifiable with the issuing bodies.
- Trademark: WOLFBLANC, EUIPO registered. Entity: Wolfblanc Architects S.L.
- Track record includes 3,500 residential units delivered for Nordic developers including
  Skanska, JM, Einar Mattsson, Bonava and Serneke.

## Services

### Architecture
https://wolfblanc.com/services/architecture/
Architecture from strategy to delivery across Spain, Sweden and Greece: feasibility, concept, technical design, approvals, tender and construction.

### BIM Consultancy
https://wolfblanc.com/services/bim/
BIM consultancy and digital coordination for architecture projects in Spain, Sweden and Greece. Federated models, clash detection and construction-ready.

### Commercial Strategy and Interiors
https://wolfblanc.com/services/commercial-interiors-hospitality/
Commercial strategy, architecture and interiors for hospitality, food and beverage, retail and workplaces, from operational brief through licensing.

### Technical Due Diligence
https://wolfblanc.com/services/due-diligence/
Independent pre-acquisition technical due diligence for property buyers in Spain, Sweden and Greece. Structural, services, damp and planning risk assessed.

### Architecture for Homeowners
https://wolfblanc.com/services/for-homeowners/
Architecture, renovations and interiors for homeowners, with clear feasibility, budget alignment, permits and construction support in Spain, Sweden and Greece.

### Architecture for Investors
https://wolfblanc.com/services/for-investors/
Independent technical advice, architecture and project control for property investors and developers, from acquisition due diligence to design, construction.

### Landscape Architecture
https://wolfblanc.com/services/landscape-architecture/
Landscape architecture as a living system. We design outdoor environments with identity, resilience and long-term value across Spain, Sweden and Greece.

### Project Management
https://wolfblanc.com/services/project-management/
Architect-led project management for new builds and total renovations in Spain, Sweden and Greece. Brief to handover, one coordinated process.

### Project Visibility and Monitoring
https://wolfblanc.com/services/project-monitoring/
Private project visibility connecting current status, milestones, site observations, visual updates and upcoming decisions throughout delivery.

### Residential Interiors
https://wolfblanc.com/services/residential-interiors/
Residential interior architecture across Spain, Sweden and Greece. Space, light, materiality and WELL-informed design developed as one coordinated project.

### Urban Design & Masterplanning
https://wolfblanc.com/services/urban-design/
Urban design and masterplanning across Spain, Sweden and Greece. Strategic spatial frameworks for neighbourhoods, waterfronts, historic centres.

### Villas and Second Homes
https://wolfblanc.com/services/villas-and-second-homes/
Architecture and project control for villas and second homes, with pre-purchase advice, local coordination and structured reporting for international clients.

### Architectural Visualization
https://wolfblanc.com/services/visualization/
Architectural visualization, renders, animations and digital staging for projects in Spain, Sweden and Greece. Design decisions, permits, sales and investor.

### Well-being Architecture & WELL Design
https://wolfblanc.com/services/wellbeing/
Well-being architecture integrating WELL standards, biophilic design, daylight, acoustics and air quality for homes, hospitality and workplaces in Spain.
